translations.text: Do you renounce the devil? I renounce him. Do you renounce the devil's works and will? I renounce them.
Do you renounce all the sacrifices and the offerings and the gods that heathen men hold as sacrifices and as offerings and as gods? I renounce them.
Do you believe in God the Father almighty? I believe. Do you believe in Christ, the Son of God, the Saviour? I believe. Do you believe in the Holy Spirit?
I believe. Do you believe in one God almighty, in Trinity and in Unity? I believe. Do you believe in the holy Church of God?
I believe. Do you believe in the forgiveness of sins through baptism? I believe. Do you believe in life after death? I believe.
